description: This file implements a command runner class for executing system commands and capturing their output, primarily used in unit tests within the Cuttlefish project.

classes.name: CmdResult
classes.description: A class encapsulating the result of executing a command, including standard output, standard error, and return code.

classes.name: CmdRunner
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing and executing system commands with specified arguments and environment variables, returning the result.

methods.name: CmdResult::CmdResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command result with stdout, stderr, and return code.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run (with Args and Envs)
methods.description: Executes the command with given arguments and environment variables, returning a CmdResult.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run (with string args and Envs)
methods.description: Tokenizes the string arguments and executes the command, returning a CmdResult.

methods.name: CmdRunner::CmdRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run (no arguments)
methods.description: Runs the command and captures stdout, stderr, and return code.

CmdRunner(Command && cmd,const cvd_common::Args & args,const cvd_common::Envs & envs)
CmdResult Run(const cvd_common::Args & args,const cvd_common::Envs & envs)
CmdResult Run(const std::string & args,const cvd_common::Envs & envs)
